title: One red circle. That’s Japan!
memory: A red sun on a snowy-white sky. Round like a big, bright cherry!
geo: Japan is a group of islands in the Pacific Ocean, beside the east coast of Asia.
hint: Look for a red circle on white.

title: A diamond with a little blue world.
memory: Green outside, a yellow diamond, then a blue ball. Spot the shapes hiding inside each other!
geo: Brazil is the biggest country in South America. Much of the Amazon rainforest grows here.
hint: Find the yellow diamond on green.

title: A leaf you’ll never forget.
memory: Two red sides hug a red maple leaf. Imagine catching that leaf on an autumn walk.
geo: Canada is in the northern part of North America, just above the United States.
hint: Find the red maple leaf.

title: Three stripes standing tall.
memory: Blue, white, red — from left to right. Picture three crayons standing in a row.
geo: France is in western Europe. It is next to Spain, Italy, and several other countries.
hint: Blue is on the left. Red is on the right.

title: Three stripes. One spinning wheel.
memory: Saffron at the top, white in the middle, green below. A blue wheel sits right in the center!
geo: India is in southern Asia. The tall Himalaya mountains are along its north, and the Indian Ocean is to its south.
hint: Look for the little blue wheel.

title: A sky full of white stars.
memory: Look for six white stars on blue. The biggest star sits under the little flag in the corner.
geo: Australia is south of Asia, between the Indian and Pacific Oceans. It is part of the region called Oceania.
hint: Australia’s stars are white, not red.

title: A shield standing guard.
memory: Black, red, and green bands, with thin white lines. A shield and two spears stand in the middle.
geo: Kenya is in eastern Africa. The equator, an imaginary line around the middle of Earth, crosses it.
hint: Look for the shield in the middle.

title: Two paths meet in a green Y.
memory: Follow the green path from the left. Two arms join into one, just like the letter Y!
geo: South Africa is at the southern end of Africa, where the Atlantic and Indian Oceans meet.
hint: Follow the big green Y.

title: Crosses crossing crosses!
memory: Straight crosses and diagonal crosses overlap. Red and white lines spread across a blue flag.
geo: The United Kingdom is in northwestern Europe, on islands just across the water from France.
hint: Look for red and white lines crossing blue.

title: Green, white, red. Stand up!
memory: Three tall stripes, just like France — but Italy starts with green instead of blue.
geo: Italy is in southern Europe. On a map, part of it looks like a boot sticking into the Mediterranean Sea.
hint: Green on the left. Red on the right.

title: A sunny cross in a blue sky.
memory: A yellow cross stretches across blue. The cross sits a little closer to the left.
geo: Sweden is in northern Europe, next to Norway and Finland.
hint: Find the yellow cross on blue.

title: A little white plus.
memory: A white cross in the middle of a red square. This flag is square, not a long rectangle!
geo: Switzerland is in central Europe. It has no ocean coast and is home to many high Alpine mountains.
hint: Find the white cross on a red square.

title: A red circle in a green garden.
memory: Just like Japan, a red circle! But Bangladesh has a green background. Look closely: the circle is slightly left of center.
geo: Bangladesh is in southern Asia, beside India and the Bay of Bengal.
hint: Find the red circle on green.

title: Green. White. Green again!
memory: Two green doors with a white path in between. Three tall stripes, but only two colors.
geo: Nigeria is in western Africa, beside the Gulf of Guinea on the Atlantic Ocean.
hint: Two green stripes hug a white one.

title: Stars in the corner. Stripes below.
memory: A blue corner holds 50 white stars. Red and white stripes run all the way across.
geo: The main part of the United States is in North America, between Canada and Mexico.
hint: Look for lots of stripes and a blue starry corner.

title: An eagle between three stripes.
memory: Green, white, red — like Italy! But Mexico adds an eagle holding a snake, standing on a cactus.
geo: Mexico is in the southern part of North America, below the United States.
hint: Find the eagle in the middle.

title: A golden sun between blue skies.
memory: Light blue, white, light blue. A golden sun peeks out of the middle stripe.
geo: Argentina is in southern South America, next to Chile and the Atlantic Ocean.

title: One big star. Four little friends.
memory: Five yellow stars on red. Find the big star first, then count its four little neighbors.
geo: China is in eastern Asia. It has a Pacific coast and shares a border with many countries.
hint: Find yellow stars on red.

title: Four red stars, far out at sea.
memory: Four red stars with white edges on a blue flag. Australia has white stars — these stars are red!
geo: New Zealand is a country of islands in the Pacific Ocean, southeast of Australia.

title: Red on top. White underneath.
